calculators.description_native: Calcule o seu salário líquido mensal em Portugal para 2026, considerando as tabelas de retenção na fonte do IRS, descontos para a Segurança Social (TSU de 11%), subsídio de refeição e deduções por dependentes e estado civil.

inputs.name: duodecimos
inputs.label_native: Pagamento de Sub. Férias e Natal em Duodécimos

calculators.formula_explanation:
1. Social Security (TSU - Taxa Social Única): Employee pays 11% flat on Gross Base Salary (Salário Bruto). Employer pays 23.75%. 
2. IRS Withholding Tax (Retenção na Fonte): Applied under the marginal rate system (Decreto-Lei update / Portaria de tabelas de retenção do IRS). The marginal withholding formula: IRS_Withholding = (Gross_Salary * Marginal_Rate) - Deduction_Amount - (Dependent_Deduction * Num_Dependents). Specific tables apply for Mainland, Madeira, and Azores, with lower tax rates for disabled workers (incapacidade >= 60%). 
3. Meal Allowance Exemption: Tax-free limits per day are €6.00 for cash payouts and €9.60 for meal card payouts (Cartão de Refeição). Any amount exceeding the daily limit is added to the taxable salary base for both IRS and TSU. 
4. Duodécimos: If selected, 1/12th or 1/24th of Vacation and Christmas bonuses are added monthly, subject to IRS withholding tables and TSU. 
5. Net Monthly Salary = Gross Salary + Total Meal Allowance - TSU (11%) - IRS Withholding Tax.

calculators.formula_explanation:
1. Taxable Base for IRS (Regime Simplificado - Art. 31º CIRS): Taxable Income = Gross Earnings * Activity Coefficient (0.75 for general professional services under Art. 151, 0.35 for unlisted services, 0.15 for sale of goods). 
2. IRS Withholding (Retenção na Fonte): Calculated directly on total gross invoice amount prior to VAT. Standard service withholding rate is 25%. Under Art. 53º (turnover threshold < €15,000 in 2026), sole traders can opt out of withholding. 
3. Social Security Contribution (Declaração Trimestral SS): Relevant monthly income base = (Gross Quarterly Income / 3) * 70% (for services; 20% for goods). Base Social Security tax rate is 21.4% (or 25.2% for Sole Proprietors / Empresários em Nome Individual). The calculated base can be adjusted by the contributor in steps of 5% up to +/- 25%. Minimum monthly contribution is €20. Maximum monthly cap applies according to IAS threshold (12 x IAS). 
4. Net Monthly Income = Monthly Gross - IRS Withholding Amount - Monthly Social Security Contribution.

calculators.title_native: Simulador de IMT, Imposto do Selo e IMT Jovem (Compra de Casa 2026)
calculators.title_en: Portugal Property Purchase Tax Calculator (IMT, Stamp Duty & IMT Jovem Exemption)
calculators.description_native: Simule com exatidão os impostos devidos na compra de imóvel em Portugal (IMT e Imposto do Selo), considerando as novas tabelas progressivas de 2026 e as isenções do IMT Jovem para jovens até 35 anos.

options.label_native: Regiões Autónomas dos Açores e Madeira

inputs.name: is_imt_jovem
inputs.label_native: Elegível para Benefício IMT Jovem (Até 35 anos inclusive)

options.label_native: Não (Idade superior a 35 anos ou não cumpre requisitos)
Sim (Todos os compradores têm até 35 anos e é a 1ª HPP)

calculators.formula_explanation:
1. IMT Calculation (Imposto Municipal sobre as Transmissões Onerosas de Imóveis): IMT = (Property Price * Marginal Tax Rate) - Deduction Amount (Parcela a Abater). Brackets are updated annually by OE (State Budget). For Continental HPP: 0% up to €101,917; 2% from €101,917 to €139,412 (deduction €2,038.34); 5% from €139,412 to €190,086 (deduction €6,220.70); 7% from €190,086 to €316,772 (deduction €10,022.42); 8% from €316,772 to €633,453 (deduction €13,190.14); flat 6% above €633,453 up to €1,102,920; flat 7.5% above €1,102,920. 
2. Stamp Duty (Imposto do Selo de Aquisição): Flat 0.8% of the acquisition value (or Taxable Asset Value - VPT, whichever is higher). If mortgage is used, an additional Stamp Duty of 0.6% applies on the loan amount (for terms > 5 years). 
3. IMT Jovem Exemption Rule: Buyers aged 35 or under purchasing their first primary residence (HPP) receive 100% exemption on IMT for purchase prices up to €316,772. For values between €316,772 and €633,453, the marginal rate of 8% applies ONLY to the portion exceeding €316,772 (with corresponding max deduction). Additionally, IMT Jovem grants 100% exemption on the 0.8% Imposto do Selo up to €316,772. 
4. Total Property Taxes = IMT Payable + Stamp Duty Payable.

calculators.title_native: Simulador de Mais-Valias Imobiliárias (IRS Categoria G)
calculators.title_en: Portugal Real Estate Capital Gains Tax Calculator (IRS Mais-Valias)
calculators.description_native: Calcule o imposto a pagar pela mais-valia gerada na venda de um imóvel em Portugal, aplicando a atualização do coeficiente de desvalorização da moeda, deduções de despesas e isenções por reinvestimento em HPP.

inputs.name: was_hpp
inputs.label_native: Imóvel Vendido era Habitação Própria Permanente (HPP)?

inputs.name: reinvestment_amount
inputs.label_native: Valor Previsto a Reinvestir em Nova HPP (€)

calculators.formula_explanation:
1. Currency Devaluation Coefficient (Coeficiente de Desvalorização da Moeda): Adjusted Purchase Price = Original Purchase Price * Coefficient(Purchase Year, published annually by Ordinance/Portaria do Ministério das Finanças). 
2. Gross Capital Gain (Mais-Valia Bruta): Gross Gain = Sale Price - Adjusted Purchase Price - Documented Expenses (e.g. Real estate agency commission, Energy Certificate, Mortgage cancellation fees, Notary/Registry fees, Home improvements done in the last 12 years). 
3. Tax Base Percentage (Artigo 43.º do CIRS): For Portuguese tax residents, only 50% of the net capital gain is added to the annual taxable income (agregado aos restantes rendimentos) and taxed at IRS progressive tax rates (13.25% to 48%). Following legal changes, non-residents are also taxed under the same 50% inclusion rule as EU residents. 
4. Reinvestment Exemption (Artigo 44.º do CIRS): If the sold property was the owner's primary residence (HPP), gains are fully or partially exempt from IRS if the sale proceeds (minus outstanding mortgage payoff) are reinvested in the purchase, construction, or land acquisition of another primary residence in Portugal or EU/EEA within 36 months after the sale (or 24 months prior to sale). Formula for taxable gain with partial reinvestment: Taxable Gain = Gross Gain * (1 - (Reinvested Amount / (Sale Price - Outstanding Mortgage Payoff))) * 50%.

inputs.name: unused_vacation_days
inputs.label_native: Dias de Férias Não Gozadas do Ano Anterior e Corrente

calculators.formula_explanation:
1. Legal Framework (Código do Trabalho Art. 366.º e Lei n.º 13/2023 Agenda do Trabalho Digno): Statutory severance pay depends on contract duration and start date regimes. Under current law (post-May 2023), compensation is calculated at 14 days of base salary + seniority pay per full year of service (or 24 days per year in specific fixed-term caducidade scenarios). For older contracts, transitional logic applies (30 days/yr prior to Nov 2011, 20 days/yr Nov 2011-Oct 2013, 12-14 days/yr post-Oct 2013). Statutory cap: Max 240 x IAS (Indexante dos Apoios Sociais) or 20 years of compensation limit. 
2. Unused Vacation Pay (Férias Não Gozadas): Each employee earns 2 days of vacation per month worked (up to 22 days per full calendar year). Salary pay for accrued unused vacation days = (Base Salary / 22) * Unused Days. 
3. Proportional Vacation Allowance (Subsídio de Férias Proporcional): Equal to the unused vacation pay. 
4. Proportional Christmas Allowance (Subsídio de Natal Proporcional): 1/12th of monthly base salary per full month worked in the current calendar year up to the termination date. 
5. Total Termination Payout = Statutory Severance Compensation + Unused Vacation Pay + Proportional Vacation Allowance + Proportional Christmas Allowance.
